scoring_justification: Headline quantities are activation energies and spontaneous polarization; only agent‑reported JSON values are available. T1 recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible. T0 exact_match with absolute tolerances is the correct fallback.

outputs.description: Activation energies for puckering reorientation of SnS and GeSe monolayers, in meV.

output_contract.notes: Scoring compares computed values to the paper's reported ones within prescribed tolerances. Exact_match policy with appropriate absolute tolerance is applied.
